learning_objective: 🎯 Explore the ancient, magical art of puppetry and learn how to bring shadows and dolls to life to tell enchanting stories!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A puppet is a special doll or figure controlled by a person called a puppeteer. By moving strings, rods, or just their hands, puppeteers make these figures walk, talk, and dance like real characters!

Shadow puppetry is super cool! You hold flat cutout puppets behind a white screen and shine a bright light on them. The audience sits on the other side and watches the giant shadows perform the story.
There are many kinds of puppets! String puppets (marionettes) are controlled from above, glove puppets fit right over your hand, and shadow puppets play with light and dark.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Nighttime Shadow Safari
fun_activity.instructions: Turn off the lights in your room and shine a strong flashlight against a blank wall. Use your hands to make shadow animals, like a barking dog or a flying bird, and make up a quick bedtime story!

quick_recap: ⭐ Puppetry is an ancient storytelling art where artists bring inanimate figures to life.
⭐ Puppeteers control characters using strings, sticks, or their own hands.
⭐ Shadow play uses a light source and a blank screen to show dark character silhouettes.
⭐ Anyone can be a storyteller by using simple homemade puppets and a lot of imagination!
